items.headline: RBI Maintains Repo Rate, Revises Down Inflation Forecast for FY27
items.summary: The Reserve Bank of India kept its benchmark repo rate at 5.25% for the fourth consecutive policy meeting and lowered its inflation forecast for FY27 to 5% from 5.1%. India's July inflation rose to 4.45% due to energy prices and rupee pressure, but remained within the RBI's tolerance.

items.headline: India's Q1 FY27 GDP Grows 7.8%; GST Rationalization and Corporate Law Amendments Expected to Boost Economy
items.summary: India's real GDP grew 7.8% in Q1 FY26-27. Government initiatives like GST rationalization and the Corporate Laws Amendment Bill 2026 aim to streamline corporate actions, enhance scrutiny, and are anticipated to boost economic growth, with Nifty 50 projected to reach 28,000 by September 2026.

items.headline: Positive Global Cues Influence Indian Markets Amid Geopolitical Tensions; Crude Prices and Yields Remain a Concern
items.summary: Indian markets are buoyed by positive global cues, including higher Asian markets and US indices, despite US-Iran geopolitical tensions. US President's remarks downplaying conflict helped sentiment. However, elevated crude oil prices (Brent >$95) and rising global bond yields pose risks, while a stronger rupee (94.352) offers some relief.

items.headline: Technocraft Ventures Reports 15.1% Net Profit Increase in Q1
items.summary: Technocraft Ventures announced a 15.1% increase in net profit and a 2.2% rise in revenue for the first quarter of the fiscal year.

items.headline: Tata Power Q1 FY27 Consolidated Net Profit Up Approximately 11% YoY
items.summary: Tata Power reported an approximate 11% year-on-year increase in its consolidated net profit for the first quarter of FY27.

items.headline: Puravankara Posts ₹29 Crore Profit in Q1FY27, Revenue Jumps 62%
items.summary: Puravankara recorded a ₹29 crore profit in Q1FY27, with its revenue increasing by nearly 62% year-on-year.

items.headline: Ashok Leyland Q1 Net Profit Rises 0.8% to ₹616 Crore, Revenue Up 12%
items.summary: Ashok Leyland's net profit for Q1 increased by 0.8% to ₹616 crore, while revenue grew by 12%.

items.headline: Bharat Dynamics Q1 Profit Surges 547% YoY, Revenue Jumps 131%
items.summary: Bharat Dynamics reported a substantial 547% year-on-year surge in Q1 profit, with revenue jumping 131%.

items.headline: Natco Pharma Q1 Profit Crashes 57% Due to Lower Lenalidomide Sales
items.summary: Natco Pharma's first-quarter profit declined sharply by 57%, primarily attributed to lower sales of lenalidomide.

items.headline: Seshaasai Technologies Reports 63.8% Q1 Net Profit Surge, to Meet Analysts
items.summary: Seshaasai Technologies saw its net profit surge by 63.8% year-on-year in Q1 FY27 and has scheduled meetings with analysts and investors on September 3-4.

items.headline: Dhoot Transmission Ltd. Q1 Results Expected on September 4, 2026
items.summary: Dhoot Transmission Ltd. is scheduled to announce its first-quarter results on September 4, 2026.

items.headline: Banking Stocks Gain in Early Trade as NIFTY Bank Rises 0.71%; FCNR-B Deposits Boost Sector
items.summary: Banking stocks, including SBI, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank, Canara Bank, and Union Bank, saw gains in early trade, with the NIFTY Bank index up 0.71%. This positive movement is linked to India attracting $127.23 billion in FCNR-B deposits under RBI's special forex swap facility.

items.headline: Nifty Auto, IT, and Media Underperform; Nifty Oil & Gas Buckets Trend
items.summary: In the previous session, the Nifty Auto index fell over 2%, while Nifty IT and Nifty Media also underperformed. Conversely, the Nifty Oil and Gas index performed well, bucking the broader market trend.

items.headline: GOCL Corporation Progressing with Merger Scheme with HNPCL
items.summary: GOCL Corporation is moving forward with its merger scheme involving HNPCL.

items.headline: Repco Home Finance Sets Sept 22 Record Date for ₹3 FY26 Final Dividend
items.summary: Repco Home Finance has announced September 22 as the record date for its final dividend of ₹3 per share for FY26.

items.headline: Hatsun Agro Product Sets Book Closure for 41st AGM
items.summary: Hatsun Agro Product has fixed its book closure for September 24-25 in preparation for its 41st Annual General Meeting.

items.headline: Moschip Technologies Involved in Litigation Over VLPL Acquisition Security
items.summary: Moschip Technologies is facing litigation concerning additional security related to its acquisition of VLPL.

items.headline: L&T Finance Allots 50,000 NCDs Worth Rs. 500 Crore
items.summary: L&T Finance successfully allotted 50,000 Non-Convertible Debentures (NCDs) amounting to Rs. 500 crore on September 2, 2026.

items.headline: Blue Star Completes Sale of MedTech Business for Up to Rs 40 Crore
items.summary: Blue Star completed the sale of its MedTech business to Cyrix effective September 1, 2026, for a consideration of up to Rs 40 crore.

items.headline: Muthoot Finance Shareholders Approve New MD and Vice Chairman Appointments
items.summary: Muthoot Finance shareholders approved the appointments of Alexander George as Managing Director and George Alexander Muthoot as Vice Chairman & Whole-Time Director, effective October 1, 2026.

items.headline: LIC Reduces Stake in SAIL by 2.00%
items.summary: Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) reduced its stake in Steel Authority of India (SAIL) by 2.00% between April 28 and September 1, 2026.

items.headline: Page Industries Receives Dubai Court Notice in Dispute with Yellow Flower
items.summary: Page Industries received a notice from a Dubai court concerning a dispute with Yellow Flower.

items.headline: KSH International Receives Unit 3 Factory License Renewal Until 2030
items.summary: KSH International's Unit 3 factory license has been renewed until December 31, 2030.

items.headline: Several Companies Schedule Corporate Actions for September 3, 2026
items.summary: Bansal Roofing Products, Carraro India Ltd, Dhoot Industrial Finance Ltd, and Hindustan Hardy Ltd are among several companies with corporate actions scheduled for today, September 3, 2026.

items.headline: Adani Ports, Power Grid, Banking Majors Among Early Gainers
items.summary: Adani Ports, Power Grid, Axis Bank, State Bank of India (SBI), and HDFC Bank were notable early gainers in today's trading. Selan Exploration Technology, AKI India, and Tribhovandas Bhimji Zaveri also performed strongly.

items.headline: Tech Mahindra, Infosys, Sun Pharma, Bajaj Finance, Hindustan Unilever Among Early Losers
items.summary: Tech Mahindra, Infosys, Sun Pharma, Bajaj Finance, and Hindustan Unilever were among the stocks declining in early trade. Annu Projects saw a significant fall. Eicher Motors, Wipro India, and Bajaj Auto were major losers in the previous session.
